overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by holding a July 14 special meeting that was not properly noticed in all four district towns, particularly Amherst; authority to convene was not decided.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee held a July 14 special meeting without providing sufficient public notice.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that because a quorum of the Committee met without posting notice of the meeting in all four towns that compose the district, the requirements of the Open Meeting Law were not met.

allegations.summary: Whether the July 14 notice posted in Amherst was adequate given the clerk's cancellation roughly 75 minutes after the notice was sent.
allegations.key_passage: Because the citizens of Amherst lacked notice of the meeting, we find that the July 14 meeting violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Dispute over whether the Chair or any member could call a special meeting; the AG considered whether the authority question affected the notice violation.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore take no position on whether Mr. Baptiste was authorized to convene the special meeting of July 14.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
